description: This dataset contains sediment geochemistry measurements collected during the GeoB16320-2 event at a single deep-sea location in the Gulf of Mexico. The records include sediment depth, total organic carbon (TOC), and total inorganic carbon (TIC) values, alongside precise spatial coordinates and an elevation of -626 meters. All samples were recorded on March 24, 2012. As a climate-related measurement set, the data serves as a valuable resource for analyzing carbon cycling and sediment composition in marine environments. Researchers can utilize these aggregated observations to study historical environmental conditions or validate models of deep-sea geochemical processes.
